title: GR180 version E compressor meanline (TC-class impeller + vaned diffuser + bend/deswirl collector)

impeller.material: Al 2618-T61 forged, 5-axis milled (TC standard); tip speed 493 m/s at T2 202 C is inside the TC range (<= 560 m/s Al at PR 4.5-5)

diffuser.build: 17 straight wedge vanes (2.5D milled into the diffuser plate, 6082-T6), prime count vs 9+9 blades; LE re-cut ring option for matching

collector.type: axisymmetric 90 deg bend + 23 deswirl vanes (2.5D on the back-plate rim) + annulus r 261..305 into the cool casing (no scroll, no pipe)
collector.note: a bought TC compressor casing (scroll) is the fallback if its inlet fits the annular plenum; then a DN250 pipe feeds the cool casing

frames.published: 400-3300 kW engines, PR <= 5.2 (Al wheel), compressor peak eta > 84 %, splitter backswept wheels, mixed-flow turbine + nozzle ring, plain bearings on squeeze film; volume-flow chart puts ~2.6 m3/s between TPS52 and TPS57
frames.fit: first choice (spare-part wheels: compressor + turbine shaft&wheel)

frames.published: TCR family 390-6700 kW engines, PR 4.7 (5.2-5.4 special), radial turbine, optional VTG nozzle
frames.source: MAN ES TCR brochure (via nauticexpo) / Riviera news
frames.fit: alternative; PBST (Velka Bites, CZ) also builds small gas turbines

frames.published: radial turbocharger for 4-stroke engines; MET16ER ~1000 kW system

frames.maker: Chinese makers (Hunan Tyen, Changzhou E&E Turbo-Power, ZJ/ Wuxi licensed lines)
frames.series: TPS/TCR-equivalent large radial TCs, spare wheels
frames.fit: cost option: wheels + friction welding to our shaft (as D2)

frames.series: Napier (UK) - owned by Wabtec (US) since 2013; Garrett / BorgWarner / Cummins Holset (US)
